observations.supportFoot: image-left/front foot fully planted under pelvis
observations.passingFoot: image-right/rear foot lifted close to ground
observations.pelvis: held above support foot with a small forward lean
observations.knees: separate readable bends; no scissor crossing
observations.feet: complete shoe silhouettes with ankle-to-shoe continuity
observations.step: restrained short passing step, not a wide stride

transferRules: Copy the support/passing relationship and knee direction only.
Rebuild the pose on the approved source character at native pixel scale.
Keep silver case in anatomical right hand and green recorder in anatomical left hand.
Do not copy the AGY face, costume changes, JPEG softness, proportions, or grip drift.
Validate full silhouette and ankle connection before adding a second pose.
